provenance.processing: original 2x2 cells; uniform Lanczos resampling to common torso silhouette area; fixed posterior root and ground; alpha<=4 cleanup; no recoloring, no nonuniform stretching, no anatomy edits
provenance.adoptionNotes: Completed 96-frame coat component reviewed before adoption. Source sheets and receipts are immutable copies, all hashes checked before/after snapshot. Native four tiers retained; 144/192 tiers uniformly downsampled from the original normalized RGBA master. No added pause/fade or frame interpolation; stand, crouch, forepaws to mouth/cheek, lower paws, stand.

rearing.model: Google Flow / Veo 3.1 Fast; built-in image_gen model not exposed by tool

flowPrompt.text:
One photorealistic agouti degu makes exactly one small vertical hop and lands on four paws. Use the supplied animal reference for the entire shot.

Strict right-facing profile: nose points to the RIGHT edge and tail extends to the LEFT, body stays parallel to the image plane for all eight seconds. Four paws settle on the same ground baseline. At 2 seconds crouch slightly; at 2.5 seconds push upward with the hind paws so all four paws lift together for a brief low hop; by 3 seconds land and stand on all four paws in the original right-facing posture. Remain calmly standing on four paws to the end. A tiny head twitch may accompany the hop. The tail follows naturally.

Locked camera and constant animal size. Single continuous real-time movement. Gray empty background matching the reference, generous padding around full body, ears, paws and long tail. One animal, four short legs, one tail. Keep the animal's appearance stable. Horizontal displacement is zero. No body rotation, no rearing on hind legs, no sitting, no second hop, no dissolve, no duplicate animal, no text.

rearing.flowReferenceUsage: same padded image at start/end; 720p/24fps/8s source

processing.method: gray key, closed silhouette, largest connected component, hole fill, fractional edge unmatting

notes: No per-frame recentering, scale change, or motion synthesis
GIF timing is quantized to 10ms; HTML and PNG duration array are the timing reference
Some subpixel whiskers lost in gray-key cleanup; not a reviewed final runtime matte
historical_jump_findings: rearing on hind feet instead of one airborne hop
ear margin as low as 3 source pixels
qa.accepted_motion: hind-foot rearing and return to four-foot posture, not a jump
